- When there is a disease outbreak [रोग उद्रेक], a more elaborate procedure of disinfection should be followed. All floors, walls up to the height of 1.5 m, interior of water trough [पिण्याचे तळ], mangers, other fittings and equipment coming in contact with animals should be disinfected.
- The first step is to remove all the filth and feed [खाद्य/चारा] residue. All dung [शेण], litter [कचरा], feed [खाद्य/चारा] residue should be removed and stacked so that the heat generated inside kills the germs. The floors, walls up to 1.5 m height, interior of mangers and water trough [पिण्याचे तळ] etc. are thoroughly scrubbed and washed with water [पाणी].
- In case of outbreak of anthrax [अँथ्रॅक्स], the dung [शेण], litter [कचरा] etc. should first be disinfected in situ by thorough sprinkling [पाण्याचा फवारणी] of suitable disinfectant. After removal of filth, the place should be scrubbed and washed with 4 % hot washing soda solution (i.e., 4 kg washing soda in 100 litre of boiling water [पाणी]). The approved disinfectant solution should be liberally sprinkled or sprayed and left so to act for 24 hours. After this, the shed [निवारा] should be washed with clean water [स्वच्छ पाणी] and left to dry [कोरडे] with wind [वारा] and sunlight.

**स्फुरद खत कसे द्यावे:**

- तेलबिया पिकांसाठी सल्फर असलेली खतेही वापरा, जसे की अमोनियम सल्फेट किंवा सिंगल सुपर फॉस्फेट.
- स्फुरदची कार्यक्षमता वाढवण्यासाठी स्फुरद विरघळविणारे जिवाणू (पी.एस.बी.) खत वापरा.

**इतर सूचना:**

**Integrated Nutrient Management [समन्वित अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन / एकात्मीक पोषक व्यवस्थापन / एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन] (INM):**

The method of using organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते], green manures, bacterial fertilizers, and organic [सेंद्रिय] liquids in appropriate proportions as complementary fertilizers along with chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] is called Integrated Nutrient Management [समन्वित अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन / एकात्मीक पोषक व्यवस्थापन / एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन].

In this method, a balance is maintained between chemical, organic [सेंद्रिय], and biological fertilizers [जैविक खत]. Also, by including leguminous crops [शेंगायुक्त पीक] in crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट], soil fertility [मातीची सुपीकता / मृदा सुपीकता] is maintained. In this method, along with bumper crop [पीक] production [उत्पादन], the quality of food grains [धान्ये] and soil [माती] is also improved. By saving expensive chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते], soil productivity [मृदा उत्पादकता] is continuously improved year after year. In this method, generally half of the total requirement of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] is supplied through chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते], and the remaining half is supplied through organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते]. It is recommended to take green manure crops [हिरवळीची खतपिके] and bury them in the soil [माती] once every three years. All crop [पीक] residues like sugarcane [ऊस] trash, sorghum [ज्वारी] stalks, wheat [गहू] and paddy stubble [खुंट], sunflower [सूर्यफूल / सुर्यफुल] stalks, and all residues of pulse [डाळ] crops, etc., are buried in the soil [माती] to increase the amount of organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ]. Along with this, it is necessary to use bacterial fertilizers and vermicompost [गांडूळखत].

**The following points should be considered while selecting chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]:**

1. For long-term crops, compound fertilizers should be used (Nitrophosphate 15:15:15) (Ammo. Phosphate 28:28:0).
2. To facilitate the availability of phosphorus [स्फुरद], completely soluble fertilizers should be selected. E.g., Single Super Phosphate, Diammonium Phosphate.
3. Sulfur-containing fertilizers should be included for pulses and oilseeds. E.g., Ammonium Sulfate, Single Super Phosphate, Ammo. Phosphate, Sulfate.
4. To increase the efficiency of phosphorus [स्फुरद], phosphorus [स्फुरद]-solubilizing bacteria [जीवाणू] (PSB) fertilizers should be used.

6. Glyricidia or young branches of Subabul [सुबाभळ] should be used as green manures.
7. Sugarcane [ऊस] molasses [मोलासेस] from sugar factories, bacterial fertilizers (Bio Earth Compost [कंपोस्ट]) should be used.

4.Potassium [पालाश]:

Potassium [पालाश] is the third most abundant mineral in the animal body and serves as the primary intracellular ion, with concentrations ranging from 100 to 160 mmol/L in body tissues. It plays a crucial role in maintaining nerve and muscle excitability, as well as regulating the body's water balance [जल संतुलन] and acid-base equilibrium. Potassium [पालाश] is also involved in cellular respiration [श्वसन] through the chloride shift and influences various intracellular processes, including enzyme function and muscle contraction.

For herbivores, potassium [पालाश] deficiency is uncommon, as most forages naturally contain adequate levels of this mineral. निंबोळी पेंडीचा वापर जमिनीच्या आरोग्यासाठी खालील पद्धतीने करा:

**माती आणि खत:**
- निंबोळी पेंड हे सेंद्रिय खत आहे आणि त्यात नत्र सुमारे ५% असते, तसेच स्फुरद आणि पालाशही असतात.
- पेरणीपूर्वी किंवा लागवडीपूर्वी माती ओलसर असताना निंबोळी पेंड शेतात मिसळून द्या.
- जैविक बुरशीनाशके (उदा. ट्रायकोडर्मा) वापरत असाल तर ती निंबोळी पेंड, शेणखत आणि सेंद्रिय खतांमध्ये मिसळून पेरणी/लागवडीच्या १५ ते २० दिवस आधी शेतात टाका; यामुळे मातीतील उपयुक्त बुरशींची संख्या वाढते.

**मात्रा आणि वेळ:**
- काही पिकांसाठी निंबोळी पेंड प्रति हेक्टर २० क्विंटल मातीत दोन टप्प्यांत (जून आणि डिसेंबर) द्या अशी शिफारस आहे.
- काही पिकांसाठी प्रति एकर १०० कि.ग्रा. निंबोळी पेंड दोन वेळा (लागवडीच्या वेळी आणि त्यानंतर एक महिन्याने) द्या अशी शिफारस आहे.

- यूरिया खत निंबोळी पेंडसोबत ५:१ प्रमाणात वापरल्यास रासायनिक खताची कार्यक्षमता वाढते.

Wood

The specific gravity of the wood is 0.72 to 0.83. The fibers in the wood grow straight and are intertwined. The wood is heavy, strong, and has a distinct odor. Since it is as strong as teak [टिक] wood, it is used for building construction. Carved art, doors, ornamental roofs can be made from wood. boxes for filling luggage, boxes for storing cigars, toys, drums, axle of bullock carts, agricultural implements, furniture etc. can be made.

Stem and Branches

Nimbin and Nimbidin components are obtained from the stem. Also, when wounds are made on the stem, a juice like gum oozes out. Although it is not used like gum, it is used as 'Neem [कडूलिंब] gum' in food in South Asia as it contains more protein [प्रथिने]. Neem [कडूलिंब] is valuable for dental health [आरोग्य]. By using a green twig like toothpaste in the morning, teeth [दात] and gums [हिरडे] can be cleaned.

Roots

The roots of Neem [कडूलिंब] penetrate deep into the soil [माती]. Also, if the roots are injured, they sprout [अंकुर] again. The tree survives in arid rangelands, rocky soils, hill slopes, acidic, saline, barren soils as well as in extremely adverse conditions. The roots go deep into the soil [माती] and absorb water [पाणी].

**Industrial Production [उत्पादन]**

Neem oil [कडुलिंबाचे तेल] is mainly used in the manufacture of soap in India. Apart from this, Neem [कडूलिंब] has an important share in the production [उत्पादन] of toothpaste, cosmetics, various creams, hair oil lotions, shampoos, nail polish, etc.

**Economics of Neem [कडूलिंब]**

The roots of Neem [कडूलिंब] first penetrate deep into the soil [माती] and then it grows. Generally, fruiting starts 5 years after planting. From a medium-sized 8-meter-tall 10 to 15-year-old tree, approximately 50 kg of leaves are produced per year. And 35 to 50 kg of seeds are obtained. Approximately 45 to 50 percent oil is obtained from fresh seeds. 400 kg of firewood is obtained from a fifteen-year-old tree. Also, various items can be made from wood. After thirty to fifty years, 0.3 cubic meters of good quality building wood is obtained from one tree.

‘Garibacha Dhanvantari’ or 'Pharmacy in the field [शेत]' which preserves nature and 'Golden Tree' which earns foreign exchange, the cultivation of Neem [कडूलिंब] will definitely provide economic benefit to the farmers.

Betel vine is a cash crop [नगदी पीक] in Vidarbha and betel vine orchards are mostly found in Akola, Amravati, Buldhana, and Yavatmal districts. The following integrated disease management [एकात्मिक रोग व्यवस्थापन] package is recommended for the management [व्यवस्थापन] of wilt disease [मररोग] of the Kapoori variety of betel vine and for better growth [वाढ] of the vines [वेली]:

**Integrated Disease Management [एकात्मिक रोग व्यवस्थापन] Package**

**Package - 1:**

a) **Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] (Seed Treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया] + Soil [माती] Application [वापर/फवारणी]):**

2. Mix 1 kg of Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] powder with 09 kg of well-decomposed manure [खत] and apply 100 grams of this mixture per square meter to the soil [माती] near the roots of the vines [वेली] at monthly intervals (from June to January).

b) **Neem Cake [कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ]:** Apply 20 quintals of neem cake [कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ] per hectare in the soil [माती], divided into two applications in June and December.

ठिबक सिंचनाद्वारे सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये देण्याची सर्वोत्तम पद्धत म्हणजे **फर्टिगेशन** — म्हणजे पाण्याबरोबर पाणी-विद्राव्य खते/पोषक द्रव्ये ठिबक प्रणालीतून मुळांच्या भागात देणे.

**पद्धत:**
- खत टाकी, व्हेंच्युरी किंवा इन्जेक्शन पंप यापैकी एक उपकरण वापरून खत पाण्यात मिसळून ठिबकने देतात.
- व्हेंच्युरीमध्ये पाण्याचा प्रवाह वाढतो व मध्यभागी दाब कमी होतो; त्यामुळे खत टाकीमधून खत शोषले जाऊन पाइपमधल्या पाण्यात मिसळते आणि ठिबकद्वारे झाडांच्या मुळांच्या भागात सोडले जाते.

**खते/पोषक द्रव्ये:**
- पाणी-विद्राव्य खते आणि सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये योग्य प्रमाणात व योग्य वेळी (पिकाच्या गरजेनुसार) ठिबकने देता येतात.
- पाणी-विद्राव्य द्रव खते बहुतेक आम्लधर्मी असतात, मीठाचा भार कमी असतो, आणि सोडियम-क्लोरीनमुक्त असल्याने मातीचे पोत टिकून राहते व उत्पादन वाढते.

**सुरक्षितता व व्यवस्थापन:**
- ठिबक प्रणाली सुरळीत चालण्यासाठी वाळू गाळणी/मेश गाळणी स्वच्छ ठेवणे, आणि गरजेनुसार अॅसिड उपचार व क्लोरीन उपचार करणे आवश्यक आहे.
- खत टाकीमधले पाणी मिसळून नंतर व्हेंच्युरीमध्ये पाईप ठेवणे, आणि ठिबक सुरू केल्यावर दोन्ही नियंत्रण व्हॅल्व्ह चालू करणे.

**Benefits of Fertigation [सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे]:**

- In the fertigation [सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे] method, labor, machinery, fuel, electricity, water [पाणी], and fertilizers are saved.
- Appropriate nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] can be given in a specific amount at the right time as per the requirement of the crop [पीक].
- Water [पाणी]-soluble liquid fertilizers are mostly acidic and have a low salt [मीठ] load, are sodium and chlorine-free, so the soil [माती]'s water [पाणी] and fertilizer [खत] are used efficiently, the soil [माती]'s fertility [प्रजननक्षमता] is maintained, and there is a good increase in production [उत्पादन].
- Water [पाणी]-soluble fertilizers are given only in the active area of the crops through drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन], so they are absorbed efficiently.
- Crops grow vigorously, are not susceptible to diseases, and the expenditure on fungicides [बुरशीनाशके] is reduced.
- Fertilizers can be given according to the growth [वाढ] of the crop [पीक], which increases the efficiency of fertilizers and increases production [उत्पादन].
- Fertilizers can be given by dividing them according to the soil [माती], crop [पीक], and weather [वातावरण] changes.
- Water [पाणी]-soluble fertilizers can be given through drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] or by spraying [फवारणी].

**Spraying [फवारणी] of Water [पाणी]-Soluble Fertilizers:**

The use of water [पाणी]-soluble fertilizers from the water [पाणी] given through fertigation [सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे] can also be used for spraying [फवारणी]. Generally, the production [उत्पादन] capacity of crops is determined by the level of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] in the leaves. results.question: भातातील Gall Midge कसा ओळखावा आणि त्याचे नियंत्रण कसे करावे?
results.answer:
भातातील गादमाशी (Gall Midge) ओळखण्यासाठी रोपांच्या अंकुरावर पांढऱ्या-पिवळसर रंगाचा कांद्याच्या पानासारखा नळीसारखा भाग दिसतो, त्याला “पोंगा” म्हणतात; गादमाशी रोगट रोपांची वाढ खुंटते आणि त्या रोपांमध्ये टिलरिंग (शाखा फुटणे) कमी होते.

**लक्षणे:**
- अंकुराभोवती कांद्याच्या पानासारखा पांढऱ्या-पिवळसर नळीसारखा भाग तयार होणे (पोंगा)
- गादमाशी रोगट रोपांची वाढ खुंटणे आणि टिलरिंग कमी होणे

**प्रतिबंध:**
- गादमाशी प्रतिकारक वाण लावा (उदा. सिंदेवाही-२००१, साकोली-८, पी.के.व्ही. गणेश)
- गादमाशी जास्त येणाऱ्या भागात शिफारस केलेल्या तारखेपेक्षा १५ दिवस लवकर पुनर्लागवड करा (२ ते २० जुलै या कालावधीत)
- चिखलणीच्या वेळी शेतात गराडी पाने १.५० टन प्रति हेक्टर टाका
- शेताभोवतीची सहाय्यक वनस्पती (देवधान) नष्ट करा
- कीडग्रस्त रोपे काढून नष्ट करा

**रासायनिक नियंत्रण:**
- गादमाशी जास्त येणाऱ्या भागात रोपवाटिकेत ५% रजत शेंडे दिसताच किंवा पुनर्लागवडीनंतर १० व ३० दिवसांनी उतारांमध्ये ७ ते १० सें.मी. पाणी असताना ग्रॅन्युलर कार्बोफ्युरान ३% @ २५ कि.ग्रा किंवा ग्रॅन्युलर क्विनॉलफॉस ५% @ ५ कि.ग्रा प्रति हेक्टर द्या आणि चार दिवस उतारांमधून पाणी काढू नका
- फवारणीसाठी लॅम्ब्डा सायहॅलोथ्रिन २.५% द्रव ५०० मि.ली. किंवा प्रेफोनील ५% द्रव १००० मि.ली. किंवा थायमेथॉक्सॅम २५% डब्ल्यू.एस. ५०० ग्रॅम प्रति ५०० लिटर पाणी यापैकी कोणतीही एक फवारणी करा

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, अकोला; डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५**

आपल्या भागात पुनर्लागवड कोणत्या तारखेला केली आहे आणि रोपवाटिकेत रजत शेंडे दिसत आहेत का?

```
**Use of Pheromone Traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] for Pest Management [कीड व्यवस्थापन]**

**Insects release a mixture of chemicals with a specific odor from their bodies to communicate with members of their own species [प्रजाती]. These chemicals create a specific reaction in them and perform the function of communication, and are called pheromones. Currently, artificially produced pheromones of some insects are available in the market for sale.**

**Pheromones are widely used to find efficient mates for mating. Insects of the opposite sex are attracted to each other for mating by its smell. We can use it for the following reasons.**

1. **To monitor pests through traps [सापळे].**
2. **To destroy the pests by catching moths in large numbers in the trap.**
3. **To prevent reproduction by creating obstacles in the mating of insects.**

**Pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] are mainly used to initiate pest control [कीड नियंत्रण] operations in various crops. For monitoring [निरीक्षण/देखरेख], 5 traps [सापळे] are sufficient in one hectare of area. A number is fixed as to how many moths should be trapped in the trap to start crop protection [पीक संरक्षण] measures. For example, if an average of 8 to 10 moths of pod borer [शेंगा पोखरणारी अळी] are found continuously for 2-3 days in each trap, then it is necessary to immediately implement pest control [कीड नियंत्रण] measures.**

**Pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] can be used to catch moths when the number of pests is very low. For this, 10 to 12 pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] are installed in one hectare of area and moths are caught in large numbers, which helps in reducing further reproduction. To create obstacles in the mating of insects, the subtle odor of sex pheromone [फेरोमोन] chemical spreads in the atmosphere through the trap. Due to this, the insects are deceived while searching for a mate for mating. As a result, there is no reproduction because they do not mate. Therefore, a decrease in the number of insects in the next generation is observed. Currently, pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] for pod borer [शेंगा पोखरणारी अळी], Spodoptera larva on soybean [सोयाबीन], larvae on eggplant, okra [भेंडी], cabbage [कोबी / पत्ता कोबी], sugarcane [ऊस], cotton [कापूस], and fruit fly [फळमाशी] are available in the market. Their price is Rs. 50 to 125 per trap. Pheromones are changed every 2 to 3 weeks. Their price is Rs. 10 to 50 per lure [आमिष].**
